BUILD / FIELD NOTES

Five signs your website has outgrown your business.

A useful redesign starts with the friction your customers feel.

01 /

Your offer has moved on

Open your homepage and compare it with the work you want to win now. If the headline describes yesterday’s business, fix the message before choosing a new layout.

02 /

The next step is hard to find

Ask someone unfamiliar with your business to find how to enquire on a phone. Watch where they hesitate. A clear action and a shorter route can matter more than another animation.

03 /

Your strongest work is missing

Replace outdated examples with relevant work you have permission to share. Explain the problem and what you delivered. Only attach results that you can substantiate.

04 /

Small updates take too much effort

List the changes you make regularly: services, work, team details or opening hours. Your publishing setup should let the right person make those edits confidently.

05 /

Start with one page

Choose the page closest to your main enquiry path. Rewrite its promise, simplify the next step and review the response before committing to a complete rebuild.
